item.title: What is the site ?
item.description:
After several switches i have finally made peace with hugo for my personal site , From jekyll to zola I tried ot several static site generators , I also used ejs to create my own site but something always seemed missing.

Hugo has all the features i want and with the typo theme my personal site is now clean , minimal and that’s what i was searching for.
